ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Execution From Parent Process In Public Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a potentially suspicious execution of a parent process located in the "\Users\Public" folder executing a child process containing references to shell or scripting binaries and commandlines.

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*bitsadmin.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*certutil.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*mshta.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*regsvr32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wscript.*"))))
